name: Summer Collection · Casual 3D
rules: Polished stylized 3D-like painted illustration, rounded appealing volumes and clean silhouettes, no dark outlines.
One dominant instantly recognizable subject; supporting parts must belong to that subject. Avoid busy microdetail.
Bright saturated but controlled colors. Use color contrast between subject and background, not a monochrome set.
Soft directional light, broad highlights, gentle ambient occlusion and believable contact shadows where appropriate.
Distinguish wood, glass, fabric, plastic and metal with simplified readable material cues; do not make everything glossy plastic.
Illustrated environments remain simple and subordinate. Realistic environment means spatially believable in the SAME stylized rendering, not photography.
No humans, character faces, gold cards, rarity effects, branded logos, card borders, stars, labels or typography.
Frame large objects boldly. Keep all identity-defining parts intact in a portrait 43:48 crop.

categories.1: Simple floating object; no ground contact. Gradient, rays, stripes or restrained repeated pattern background.
categories.2: Simple object resting on a surface; behind it a simple vertical plane or gradient/pattern background.
categories.3: Object on a recognizable realistic material surface, with spatial depth and a restrained simple background; limited contextual details.
categories.4: Main object integrated into a recognizable surrounding environment. The environment supports the story but the object stays dominant.
